claims.evidence: Paper Methods identify HeLa S3 lines for chaperone pulldowns, state HeLa S3 female origin, and the registry lookup maps HeLa S3 to CVCL_0058. PRIDE structured organism says Mus musculus, inconsistent with this experiment-specific Methods; paper and cell-line evidence take precedence. Cellosaurus lookup supplies donor-tissue disease Human papillomavirus-related cervical adenocarcinoma and Tissue: Cervix. The tissue is encoded with Uberon preferred term uterine cervix (UBERON:0000002).

claims.location: comment[proteomics data acquisition method], comment[instrument], comment[cleavage agent details], comment[precursor mass tolerance]
claims.value: PRM; Q Exactive HF; Trypsin; 5 ppm
claims.evidence: Paper histone PTM LC-MS Methods explicitly state PRM positive mode, Q Exactive HF, trypsin digestion and Skyline precursor tolerance 5 ppm; PRIDE protocol and instrument agree.

Results workbook index calls the four histone PTM experiments LFQ. Paper states heavy peptide standards were spiked at 166 fmol each, which serve as internal standards rather than multiplex labels for these samples.

limitations: PRIDE structured organism is Mus musculus, whereas the experiment-specific Methods identify HeLa S3 human cells.
Heavy peptide standards are reported as 166 fmol each, but individual peptide identities are not available in the deposited sources reviewed; no spiked-compound components were invented.
The exact Skyline search modification list was not deposited; modification parameters are omitted rather than inferred from the measured histone PTMs.
Dissociation method and fragment tolerance are not explicitly named in the project record; both are not available.

Project-record reconciliation may flag donor-tissue disease on siRNA control rows by interpreting `NC` as a healthy control; these are negative-control siRNA runs in the same HeLa S3 line, and the Cellosaurus donor diagnosis applies to every row.
